name: Aelnir Screenshot Stitcher

screenshots.alt: Home: pick screenshots to stitch vertically, horizontally or quick merge
Settings: default direction, format, quality and privacy options

seoTitle: Aelnir Screenshot Stitcher: combine screenshots into one long image
summary: Stitch several screenshots into one clean long image, offline.
tagline: Pick your screenshots and get one tidy long image. The app finds the overlap and hides repeated headers for you.

features.title: One long image, no seams
features.lead: Matching and stitching run on your phone.

items.title: Automatic order and overlap
items.body: Puts the screenshots in order and finds where each one overlaps the next, with a confidence score.

items.title: Fixed bars removed
items.body: Detects status bars, app bars and bottom navigation, and masks them from the seams.

items.title: Vertical or horizontal
items.body: Stitch in either direction, or just merge screenshots with an optional gap or divider.

items.title: Manual alignment
items.body: Fine-tune any seam with an edge overlay and pixel nudges.

items.title: Mark up
items.body: Crop, redact with solid, blur or pixelate, and add arrows, boxes, text and highlights.

items.title: Export your way
items.body: PNG, JPEG, WebP or PDF, at a width or file size you choose, with no watermark.

note.label: Free, with ads
note.title: No watermark, nothing uploaded
note.body: Aelnir Screenshot Stitcher is free and supported by ads. Your screenshots are processed on your device.

privacy.headline: Your screenshots never leave your phone.
privacy.lead: The app needs no account and has no server. Screenshots are matched, stitched and exported on your device. The free app shows ads through Google AdMob, whose SDK collects limited device and usage data, never your images.

studioProof.hard: Pairwise overlap scoring and content-aware seams that work on very large outputs.
